_documentation: Single source of truth for NetSec brand primitives. scripts/inject-seo.py reads colours.primary (the structured-data theme-color) and assets.org_logo (the JSON-LD Organization.logo) from here, so those can no longer drift. The static mirrors that a browser reads directly (manifest.webmanifest theme_color, the :root --accent / --accent-2 tokens in assets/css/site.css) cannot read this file at runtime, so scripts/check-brand.py asserts they match it on every brand-touching PR. When a brand value changes: change it here AND in the static mirrors in the same PR; the brand-lint gate enforces the match. The working_groups palette is recorded here as the canonical source for when the WG colours are tokenised (currently still inline in site.css / working-groups.html, tracked as a follow-up); it is not yet enforced by the lint.
